text:
maria_cs: Tangelo.ai submitted an onboarding request for a multimodal reranker (images + text). They want Private deployment (VPC), HSM integration, and a quantized 13B variant. Form/attachments: https://airtable.com/tangelo-onboard-req — @sam_eng can you triage infra feasibility? Also flagging renewal risk: they're on Pro plan, their renewal conversation hinges on this rollout.

sam_eng: Looking. Quick question — do their samples include PHI or just PII? The form mentions receipts and customer photos; important for isolation and redaction.

tangelo-csm: Correct — mostly receipts and occasional ID-style selfies for verification (~2% of flows). All PII must be processed on-prem or in VPC. We will redact where possible but need the pipeline to support encrypted uploads. Latency target: <=250ms p95.

priya_prod: Noted latency. My recommendation: Dedicated capacity (reserved) for predictable p95. For image payloads, continuous batching should be off; images are variable. @tony_sre can you do a quick infra/cost estimate and confirm whether HSM in our Private offering covers their key requirements?

tony_sre: :eyes: I'll run perf sims. Also we need an eval harness: ask Tangelo for ~3k labeled image+text pairs (train/val split) to run safety and accuracy checks. We'll also run attribute distribution checks for sensitive attributes.

maria_cs: Tangelo says they can provide ~5k samples staged to an S3 bucket after we sign the AFA. Quick business note: renewal is Q4; this feature will likely trigger a Dedicated annual deal if onboarding goes smoothly — high priority.

sam_eng: Draft config for staging run: 
```yaml
model: tangelo-reranker-multi-13b-q8
quantization: int8
batching:
  image_stream: false
  token_stream: adaptive
cache:
  prefix_kv: false
vpc: true
hsm: true
streaming: false
```
Will iterate based on perf. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

priya_prod: Add runtime safety filters: safe-output-filter: enabled, plus score_thresholds for rerank cutoffs. Eval goals: accuracy@10 >= 0.78, safety-violation-rate < 0.1%, latency p95 <= 250ms. Also plan an A/B run with their heuristic baseline.

tony_sre: Early estimate: with 2x A10G equiv and optimized kernels we should hit ~180-220ms p95 for typical 512-token + image flows. I will follow up with a cost spreadsheet and a node sizing recommendation.

ops-bot: Onboarding ticket created: ORG-4821. Assigned: sam_eng, maria_cs. Due date: 2 weeks from ticket creation.

sam_eng: I'll provision a staging cluster and push an onboarding checklist (S3 access, encryption key rotation, sample schema, eval scripts). For HSM we need their KMS policy + rotation cadence.

tangelo-csm: We'll share S3 access and HSM requirements today, and request a 2-hour enablement workshop for their product + eng team next week. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
